Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ fabdbcac6bfa5133a2c9e13f568c9efd32e401e9

Verdict FINDINGS

- P1 — crates/app/src/mcp/align_tools.rs:71: Align a cylinder to X with angle_deg=21, then the same pick to Y with angle_deg=33 and flip=true. Both calls succeed, but the stored transform sends the original Z cylinder axis to [0.8386705679, 0, -0.5446390350], perpendicular to Y. This can machine the wrong face. A temporary extension of the cylinder pin failed on this case. The existing backend at crates/app/src/pick/cylinder.rs:218-220 reads view_pose (including the active alignment), then applies the supplied alignment again. Fix the shared path and pin consecutive alignments before exposing it here.
- .claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:150: This process-file change lacks the required `Process change: yes` line in the PR body (AGENTS.md process-change rule).

Tests: all three named pins GREEN. Quick gate GREEN: 326 passed, 1 ignored. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` GREEN. Local merge with upstream/main succeeded.

Mutations: target RED; angle RED; source RED; point RED; vertex-with-point RED; box-with-pick RED; unchanged-origin RED; cylinder setup bypass RED; origin setup bypass RED. Finite-filter removal GREEN (JSON numbers cannot carry nonfinite values). Missing-pick guards replaced with Null fallback GREEN for both tools; missing-pick pins are absent and shared pick validation still rejects Null. All mutations restored; final three pins GREEN; worktree clean.

Other checks: changed Rust files are under 400 lines; no new production unwrap/expect/panic; no golden changes or prohibited PNG, PROCESS_VERSION, dependency, .github or scripts changes. Changelog and Fixes lines present. No code pushed and no labels changed.
